concepts.title: Adding Algebraic Expressions
concepts.formula: sum like terms: m x + n x = (m + n) x

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 2 when x = 7.
Find the value of 2x^2 + 7x + 5 when x = 5.
Simplify 9x + 4x - 2x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 6 x (9 + 4) equals 6 x 9 + 6 x 4. Compute it.
Evaluate 5 + 5 x 6 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (6 + 8) x 8.

concepts.title: Subtracting Algebraic Expressions
concepts.formula: m x - n x = (m - n) x

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 7 when x = 3.
Find the value of 2x^2 + 3x + 5 when x = 3.
Simplify 3x + 3x - 9x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 8 x (7 + 6) equals 8 x 7 + 8 x 6. Compute it.
Evaluate 6 + 3 x 6 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (7 + 6) x 7.

concepts.title: Monomials, Binomials, Polynomials and Like Terms
concepts.formula: 1 term = monomial; 2 terms = binomial; 3 terms = trinomial

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 3 when x = 4.
Find the value of 6x^2 + 3x + 5 when x = 3.
Simplify 8x + 8x - 3x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 5 x (9 + 5) equals 5 x 9 + 5 x 5. Compute it.
Evaluate 8 + 9 x 5 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (8 + 5) x 4.

concepts.title: Multiplying Two Monomials
concepts.formula: (a x^m) x (b x^n) = (a x b) x^(m+n)

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 5 when x = 6.
Find the value of 2x^2 + 4x + 5 when x = 6.
Simplify 4x + 2x - 9x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 9 x (7 + 8) equals 9 x 7 + 9 x 8. Compute it.
Evaluate 5 + 8 x 4 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (5 + 2) x 2.

concepts.title: Multiplying Three or More Monomials
concepts.formula: (a) x (b) x (c) = ((a x b) x c)

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 3 when x = 5.
Find the value of 3x^2 + 2x + 5 when x = 6.
Simplify 7x + 6x - 7x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 2 x (6 + 8) equals 2 x 6 + 2 x 8. Compute it.
Evaluate 8 + 6 x 2 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (2 + 9) x 5.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Monomial by a Binomial or Trinomial
concepts.formula: a x (b + c) = a x b + a x c

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 8 when x = 2.
Find the value of 3x^2 + 5x + 5 when x = 3.
Simplify 7x + 8x - 9x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 3 x (3 + 3) equals 3 x 3 + 3 x 3. Compute it.
Evaluate 2 + 2 x 9 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (3 + 2) x 2.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Binomial by a Binomial
concepts.formula: (a + b) x (c + d) = a x c + a x d + b x c + b x d

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 7 when x = 9.
Find the value of 2x^2 + 2x + 5 when x = 2.
Simplify 8x + 3x - 8x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 9 x (5 + 9) equals 9 x 5 + 9 x 9. Compute it.
Evaluate 3 + 3 x 4 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (6 + 3) x 3.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Binomial by a Trinomial
concepts.formula: (a + b) x (c + d + e) = a x c + a x d + a x e + b x c + b x d + b x e

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 7 when x = 7.
Find the value of 5x^2 + 3x + 5 when x = 5.
Simplify 7x + 9x - 8x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 7 x (4 + 9) equals 7 x 4 + 7 x 9. Compute it.
Evaluate 4 + 7 x 6 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (9 + 5) x 2.
